title: Enhancing Understanding of Language Models with Varied Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2611.25314v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models are increasingly used to support human judgement in complex reasoning tasks, yet their predictions often remain difficult to interpret and validate. Explainability techniques provide insight into model decision-making, helping expose errors, failure modes, and potential bias so users can decide whether to rely on model outputs. Explanations are simplified approximations of a language model's internal workings. The goal is to obtain explanations that reflect the underlying computation as closely as possible (faithfulness), are understandable to users (plausibility), and help them achieve their intended goals (utility). Evaluation protocols are essential for assessing these dimensions. This thesis studies highlight explanations, natural language explanations, and chain-of-thought reasoning. These forms offer complementary perspectives on model behaviour and exhibit distinct strengths and limitations across tasks. Producing

translated_title: 通过多样化解释增强对语言模型的理解
translated_abstract: 语言模型越来越多地被用于在复杂推理任务中辅助人类判断，但其预测往往仍然难以解释和验证。可解释性技术能够深入洞察模型的决策过程，帮助揭示错误、失效模式和潜在偏见，从而让用户能够决定是否信任模型输出。解释是语言模型内部运作的简化近似，其目标是获得尽可能忠实反映底层计算（忠实性）、对用户而言易于理解（合理性）、并能帮助用户实现预期目标（实用性）的解释。评估协议对于衡量这些维度至关重要。本论文研究了高亮解释、自然语言解释和思维链推理三种解释形式。这些形式为模型行为提供了互补的视角，并在不同任务中展现出各自的优势与局限性。
tldr: 本论文系统研究了高亮解释、自然语言解释和思维链推理等多种解释形式，并从忠实性、合理性和实用性三个维度评估其对语言模型可解释性的互补贡献。
en_tdlr: This thesis investigates highlight explanations, natural language explanations, and chain-of-thought reasoning, evaluating their complementary contributions to language model explainability along the dimensions of faithfulness, plausibility, and utility.
